title: Etsivä Romppainen ja Lakkahaltian Salaisuus
subtitle: A ward, a sealed annex, and a place nobody published

player_sheet.name: Dr. Harri S. Romppainen

psionics._note: Effort maximum follows the SWN shape adopted in the baseline: 1 + the better of WIS/CON + the highest psionic skill.

player_sheet._skill_names_note: CWN skill vocabulary. The retired scenario-local labels (Investigate, Psychology) map to Know and are not used by any check.

opening_objective: Interview the ward staff, then the patient. Consent before questions.

objectives.text: Interview the doctor, the nurse and the patient.
Find out why the patient's file is sealed by a research ethics board.
Decide what the account is: a shared ward story, misconduct — or something anchored to a place.

endings.title: Filed as an ethics breach
endings.text: The cluster is ward culture plus a resealed trial and a real consent failure. Nobody is helped today, but nothing false is written down either. The report names no anomaly.

endings.title: Referred, not resolved
endings.text: The account is anchored to a place the study never published, and the file shows the trial knew. The case goes to the referral partner with the anomaly stated as an open question, never as a finding.
